title: SEP-1303: Input Validation Errors as Tool Execution Errors
excerpt: SEP 1303: Input Validation Errors as Tool Execution Errors Status : Final Type : Standards Track Created : 2025 08 05 Author(s) : @fredericbarthelet Issue : 1303 Abstract This SEP proposes treating tools input validation errors as Tool Execution Errors rather than Protocol Errors. This change would enable language models to receive validation error feedback in their context window, allowing them to self correct and successfully complete tasks without human intervention, significantly improving task completion rate....
